policy:
Exclude Parent Plans, later siblings, and [USER OVERALL GOAL] from Current Task requirements. Parent Completed Calls may provide already-known factual values for constructing Current Task tool arguments, but only Current Task Completed Calls can prove Current Task completion. Decide the entire explicit [CURRENT TASK], not merely its first verb.

[**workflow_complete**]
Select only when a [COMPLETED CALLS] section inside the Current Task message contains confirmed results that already state every requested fact and prove every requested side effect. Evidence describing the current faulty content does not prove that a requested modification happened. Then Complete is mandatory only when the requested final state is proven. If the section is absent or any requirement remains, workflow_complete is forbidden; never use its answer to explain unfinished work.

[**workflow_infeasible**]
Select only when Current Task context explicitly proves a permanent missing capability/input/fact/device/credential/access path, contradiction, forbidden sole path, destroyed data, or exhaustion of materially different Plans. An uninspected file, URL, package, or implementation is not infeasible. A task needing inspection plus later work is Plan.

[**workflow_plan**]
Select whenever the Current Task explicitly contains two or more distinct operations, requested outcomes, dependent stages, or independent targets that are not already satisfied by confirmed context. This rule is mandatory before any first operation. Signals include then/after/followed by, obtain and use, read and modify when current content is unknown, inspect and fix when the implementation is unknown, research and write, fetch multiple sources and reconcile, download and verify/install, install and verify, start and wait/read output, deploy and probe, list and read/summarize, run two commands and compare, branch then record, or update multiple targets. Do not call read, search, fetch, list, command, outline, or start_process first. Multiple parallel calls and a compound shell command still require Plan. Return at least two outcome goals inside Current Task and materially different from [FAIL PLANS].

[**ordinary tool**]
Select the exact ordinary tool when one invocation's normal operation and return value fully satisfy the whole Current Task. These are always single-call direct matches unless the Goal explicitly requests another unsatisfied operation: read one file and return contents; write one file whose path, structure, and factual values are already available anywhere in context; fetch one specified URL and return its page; perform one web search and return results; list one directory; search one path; run one command and return output/status; inspect one outline; query environment; replace one exact known block; start only; stop only; or read one process output. A Goal that only says to write result.json with specified fields is one write_file call when parent completed results already contain the field values. A Goal that only says to modify/fix one file is one replace_in_file call when Current Task Completed Calls already contain the current implementation and parent completed results already define the expected behavior. In that case, the read/inspection stage is already satisfied: NEVER call read_file again, NEVER return multiple read_file calls, and NEVER Plan; construct old_str from the confirmed current implementation and new_str from the confirmed expected behavior. The known content, URL, query, command, path, or process ID is already an input and does not need a discovery Goal. Do not invent verification, discovery, or parent archival work.

Return exactly one native function call. Never emit multiple ordinary calls. The selected function and its arguments must agree semantically.
